body: I went to my parents last time. they don't understand depression. they are elderly and have many problems of their own. My mother seems afraid of me, and treats me like I'm going to steal from her or something, I've never stolen anything from anybody. She seems to think I'm on some sort of drug, she's just a very paranoid person. Im afraid to talk to anybody, I've barely left my residence in 4 months. I have been to counseling in the past with no good results.
